name: Red Beet Food Coloring
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors

ingredients.item: 2 medium beetroots, peeled and cut into chunks

steps: Blend beets and water in a food processor.
Using a cheesecloth, strain the purée into a bowl to extract the juice.
Pour the juice into a saucepan and add sugar.
Turn the heat to medium-high, and stir to dissolve the sugar.
Skim off and discard any foam that collects at the surface of the liquid.
Simmer until the liquid reduces to a single-thread consistency.
Turn off the heat and stir in the lemon juice.
Cool slightly, then pour into an airtight jar and cool completely.

culture.text: Food coloring, color additive or colorant is any dye, pigment, or substance that imparts color when it is added to food or beverages. Colorants can be supplied as liquids, powders, gels, or pastes. Food coloring is commonly used in commercial products and in domestic cooking.
